name: APA Hotel Nagoya Ekimae
detail: The accommodation is well-located, within easy walking distance to the core shopping district and convenient for shopping. The room is tidy and clean, with complete facilities. The building is situated in a quiet alley at night, ensuring good sleep quality. The staff are friendly and professional, with attentive service. Overall, it offers great value for money and is a recommended option.

name: APA Hotel Nagoya Fushimi Ekikita
detail: The quiet and clean room and bathroom were impressive enough for a good night's sleep, and its excellent accessibility made it very convenient for shopping. Thanks to the friendly attitude of the staff and various amenities, I had an overall satisfying time. The value for the price was also excellent, making it a place I would like to visit again.

name: APA Hotel Nagoya Marunouchi Ekimae
detail: Not only did I stay at a reasonable price, but by becoming a member of the APA app, I was able to extend my checkout by one hour! Thanks to that, I was able to relax. There was also an onsen, so I really enjoyed my time! Being close to the station was also appealing.

name: 9h nine hours Nagoya station
detail: There are many foreign travelers, but everyone has good manners, and from young people to elderly individuals like myself, I was able to spend a night safely, securely, and cleanly without much inconvenience. It's about a 5-minute walk from the station, and there’s a FamilyMart nearby. There is also a famous ramen restaurant right around the corner. The night view from the lounge on the 18th floor of the Nagoya location is not very good due to the tall buildings blocking it, but you can have meals, work, or read in the comfort of a counter with sofas and outlets. The shower room is spacious and clean, and the provided towel set is large and fluffy, which should be sufficient even for a person with a robust physique. One slight dissatisfaction was that, even when there was a queue at check-in, there was only one young male staff member at the reception, and I think this could be improved.

name: APA Hotel Nagoya Sakae Ekimae EXCELLENT
detail: I used it for a business trip. The following points were very good: - Close to the station / easy (straight from exit 2) - The room is spacious (ample size for one person) - There is a desk that is just right for computer work - There is a laundry (with automatic detergent dispenser) - Strong water pressure (toilet, faucet, shower) - A small heater can be borrowed when it's cold (brought to the room) - Towels are changed every day - Quiet - Luggage can be stored after checkout - There are convenience stores, drugstores, and McDonald's nearby.

name: Kuretake Inn Premium Nagoya Nayabashi
detail: Within walking distance from Nagoya Station. The loop bus from the front of the station makes the Yanagibashi bus stop very convenient. There is a bathhouse within the building that can be used as many times as desired during the available hours. Breakfast is included in some plans. There are many restaurants, convenience stores, and drugstores nearby, so shopping is not a problem. Amenities and loungewear are available near the front desk, and guests can choose and take them to their rooms. There is an evening welcome drink time. The cost performance is very good.

name: Nagoya Tokyu Hotel
detail: I was invited to a wedding and stayed at the Tokyu Hotel near Nagoya Station since there was no accommodation at the venue. Arriving early, they kindly stored my luggage, allowing me to spend the time meaningfully until check-in. I was informed that there were no smoking rooms available, and was directed to the smoking area. The room was well-equipped with towels and amenities. The cleaning was thorough, and the room was clean. I felt that the lighting in the room was a bit dim; perhaps because it was dark, I was able to sleep well. There was a taxi stand inside the hotel, which I used to get to the venue. It was nice that there was Sekai no Yamachan behind the hotel, which I could walk to. I was able to choose my breakfast, and since I had the chance, I had it at Nadaman. It was delicious. I would appreciate it if there is another opportunity.

name: Sanco Inn Nagoya Shinkansenguchi
detail: I used this hotel during a business trip to Nagoya. It's located just across the main street from the Shinkansen exit, about a minute's walk from the station. There are convenience stores, izakayas, and standing bars nearby, so I think there are plenty of dining options. At check-in, there was a tablet at the counter, but the staff accompanied me and provided assistance. The room wasn't very spacious, but it was well cleaned and sufficient for a comfortable stay. Above all, its proximity to the station is a big attraction.

name: Hostel Wasabi Nagoya Ekimae
detail: This time I used it for an overnight stay before the Nagoya Women's Marathon 2026. It's very close to Nagoya Station and convenient! There's a Lawson nearby. It's quiet and clean. The bedding is also nice and fluffy. I was able to sleep soundly. There are drinks and miso soup available. The staff are very friendly. It's a safe place to stay. The other guests seem accustomed to guesthouses as well, and the manners are good. Toothbrushes and towels are available for a fee, but it's cheap. There is also free lending of cosmetics like lipstick. They offer luggage storage before check-in and after check-out. It's 300 yen. There are time restrictions. Station lockers cost around 700 to 800 yen, so this is a good deal. It seems like there are many repeat visitors. I will use it again when I come to Nagoya next time!

name: Sanco Inn Nagoya Shinkansenguchi Annex
detail: This hotel is immediately visible when you exit the Taiko-dori gate, which is close to the Shinkansen ticket gate. You definitely won’t get lost! The rooms are clean and there's no complaint. The front desk staff was also kind. However, I think it’s only for a limited time, but there seems to be construction happening a little distance away at night, and I could hear some noise. Personally, it wasn’t bothersome to me. I would like to use it again when I stay in Nagoya.
